changelog: Fixed right-click Combine into PDF on Windows, macOS and Linux (cicd issue 08): flat Explorer verb, binary-owned --install-context-menu registration, installers no longer pin the registrar to a release tag.
CLI accepts multiple positional files (jpg2pdf a.png b.pdf c.docx) so file-manager %F selections merge in order; fixed the KDE Dolphin Exec line to use --files %F.
Word merge is cross-platform: docx2pdf/MS Word, then LibreOffice headless, then a built-in .docx text fallback; Word files are never silently dropped.
Added mixed-input merge tests and cross-platform context-menu tests that run in Ubuntu CI.
